chapters.title: A. Cypress vs Playwright vs Selenium — comparison table
chapters.overviewText: This appendix is the interview table: execution model, browsers (no first-class WebKit in Cypress), waiting, tabs/origin, languages, debugging (no Cypress Trace Viewer), CT, visual (no Cypress built-in), API, sessions, parallel (machines vs workers), mobile (Appium for native), commercial Cloud vs OSS. Use it with Parts 0 and 9 — do not memorize rows without the architecture sentence.
chapters.why: Almost every senior screen starts here. A table without 'why' is a junior answer; this chapter supplies both.
chapters.when: Before interviews (13.3), when choosing a tool for a new Bizlevate surface, and when a PM asks 'can Cypress replace everything.'

practical.scenario: You must recommend a stack for web HRM, Safari-critical marketing, and a native iOS app.
practical.pass: You put Cypress on JS web+CT, Playwright on Safari/multi-tab/trace-heavy CI, Appium on native, Selenium only if the org is already JVM-deep.
practical.fail: You pick one tool for all three surfaces.

chapters.customSummary:
- Cypress: in-page, JS/TS, CT strength, GUI; weak tabs/WebKit/trace zip.
- Playwright: external CDP, WebKit, trace.zip, workers, languages.
- Selenium: WebDriver, broad languages/browsers, Grid; more assembly.
- Native mobile: Appium for all three (not Cypress/Playwright).
- Parallel in Cypress = machines sharding specs.
chapters.contentMarkdown:
## Master table

| Topic | Cypress | Playwright | Selenium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Execution | In-browser, command queue | External, CDP/WebSocket | External, WebDriver HTTP |
| Languages | JS/TS only | JS/TS, Python, Java, .NET | Many |
| Browsers | Electron, Chrome, Edge, Firefox; **no first-class WebKit** | Chromium, Firefox, **WebKit** | Most, via drivers (incl. SafariDriver) |
| Auto-wait | Command + assertion retry-ability | Actionability + expect retries | Historically manual; improving |
| Cross-origin | `cy.origin({ args })` | Transparent | Transparent |
| Multi-tab | **No switchToTab**; href/request/stubs | Pages/popups | Window handles |
| Shadow DOM | Opt-in `includeShadowDom` / `.shadow()` | Open shadow pierced by default | `getShadowRoot()` |
| Debugging live | App time-travel / UI Mode | Inspector / UI Mode | IDE debugger |
| Post-mortem | Screenshots/videos; **no Trace Viewer**; Cloud Replay paid | **trace.zip** | Vendor video/logs |
| Component testing | **First-class `cy.mount`** | Exists, less central (esp. Python) | None |
| Visual regression | **No built-in** (plugin/SaaS) | Built-in screenshot matcher | Plugin/SaaS |
| a11y | **cypress-axe** (axe-core) | axe-core wrappers | axe-core wrappers |
| API | `cy.request` same session | Isolated APIRequestContext | REST libs |
| Session | `cy.session` | storageState / context | cookies by hand |
| Parallel | **Machines × spec shards** (Cloud smart split paid) | Workers + shard | Grid nodes |
| CI helper | **cypress-io/github-action**; **cypress/browsers** images | playwright install / Microsoft images | driver/Grid images |
| Dashboard | Cloud; **Sorry Cypress / Currents** | OSS HTML+trace; vendor clouds | Vendor clouds |
| Reports | **Mochawesome two-part** (JSON then merge) | First-party HTML + blob merge | Allure/Extent/JUnit |
| Logging | **cy.task** (Node) vs **cy.log** (GUI) | console in Node test | framework logs |
| Native mobile | **No — Appium** | **No — Appium** | Appium (WebDriver family) |
| Device emulation | `cy.viewport` (size) | viewport + UA + WebKit | Chrome options |
| Origin company | Cypress.io, Cloud revenue | Microsoft | Open community + vendors |
| First public | 2017 | 2020 | 2004 |

## How to say it in 30 seconds

"Cypress runs inside the page — best GUI and CT for a JS HRM, but I wrap SSO in `cy.origin`, I don't do tabs, I don't have WebKit or a trace zip, and parallel means more CI machines. Playwright is the external driver with WebKit and traces. Selenium is the WebDriver ecosystem. Native is Appium."

## Decision cheat

- Frontend-owned React HRM, Chromium-majority users → **Cypress**.
- Must catch Safari engine bugs or drive two tabs → **Playwright** (or add it).
- Java org, existing Grid → **Selenium** until a rewrite is funded.
- Store apps → **Appium** always.

Interview line: "I can fill this table and explain every Cypress 'no' as architecture, not as missing homework."

chapters.title: B. Useful plugins
chapters.overviewText: Cypress stays small; plugins fill tags, a11y, reports, images, grep, parallel-on-one-machine, Testing Library queries, and real events. Core already has selectFile, intercept, session, origin — do not install fossils (cypress-file-upload, cy.server helpers). Pin plugins to your Cypress major. Playwright needs fewer plugins because more is first-party (visual, HTML report, grep).
chapters.why: A plugin is a dependency you will debug on upgrade day. This list is the ones this manual already taught plus a short bench.
chapters.when: When starting a repo, when replacing Cloud (11.5), and when a blog recommends five overlapping plugins.

practical.scenario: You are scaffolding Bizlevate's Cypress repo and must pick a minimum plugin set.
practical.pass: You add @cypress/grep, cypress-axe, a Mochawesome two-part reporter, and only then image-snapshot or Testing Library if the team wants them.
practical.fail: You install cypress-file-upload, cypress-wait-until for every get, and three reporters that overwrite each other.

chapters.customSummary:
- grep plugin, cypress-axe, mochawesome pipeline, optional image-snapshot.
- @testing-library/cypress if you prefer role queries.
- cypress-real-events for hover closer to OS; still not iOS.
- Sorry Cypress/Currents are services, not npm-only.
- Prefer built-in: selectFile, intercept, session, origin, includeShadowDom.
chapters.contentMarkdown:
## Taught in this manual (install these when you need the chapter)

| Plugin / package | Chapter | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `@cypress/grep` | 10.1 | Tags / smoke |
| `cypress-axe` + `axe-core` | 9.7 | a11y |
| `cypress-mochawesome-reporter` or mochawesome + **merge** + marge | 11.6 | HTML reports |
| `cypress-image-snapshot` (or Percy SDK) | 9.6 | Visual — not built-in |
| `cypress-parallel` | 9.8 | Multi-process on one machine |
| `@testing-library/cypress` | 4.x | `findByRole` etc. |
| `cypress-real-events` | 9.17 | closer pointer events |

## Services, not just plugins

Sorry Cypress, Currents, Cypress Cloud, Applitools/Percy — Part 11 / 9.6.

## Usually unnecessary now

- `cypress-file-upload` — use `cy.selectFile`.
- `cypress-iframe` — often wrap/origin; check current recipes.
- `cypress-wait-until` — usually a smell; prefer `.should` / `@alias`.
- Old `cypress-plugin-snapshots` without maintenance — check dates.

## Plugin hygiene

Register in `support/e2e.ts` **and** `setupNodeEvents` when the plugin says so (grep). Pin versions. Read Cypress peerDependency on major bump.

## Versus Playwright and Selenium

Playwright: grep, HTML report, screenshot matcher, trace — **core**. Selenium: a zoo of language bindings and Allure adapters. Cypress's plugin culture is closer to "jQuery of test tools" — powerful, easy to over-install.

Interview line: "Minimum set: grep, axe, report merge. Visual is a plugin because Cypress has no built-in matcher."

chapters.title: C. Cheat sheet of commands
chapters.overviewText: A one-page command map for day-to-day HRM specs: visit/get/contains/find, click/type/select/selectFile, should/and, intercept/wait/request, session/origin, mount, screenshot/viewport, task/log, grep tags. It is not the API docs. Playwright equivalents are listed so you do not type page.locator in a Cypress file.
chapters.why: Pairing interviews and code review go faster with a sheet that includes the dangerous ones (origin args, no switchToTab, task vs log).
chapters.when: While writing specs, and the night before a pairing interview.

practical.scenario: You need to write a leave-submit spec from memory including intercept and session.
practical.pass: You produce session → intercept → visit → wait → get data-cy → click → assert, and you never await cy.get.
practical.fail: You write driver.findElement or await cy.get('.btn').

chapters.customSummary:
- Query: get/contains/find; chain should.
- Network: intercept before trigger; wait @alias; request for API.
- Auth: session; SSO: origin + args.
- CT: mount. Artifacts: screenshot. CI log: task.
- There is no switchToTab / show-trace.

chapters.title: D. Common error messages & fixes
chapters.overviewText: Cypress errors are often English sentences: timed out retrying, detached from DOM, origin mismatch, Cypress detected you returned a promise, cy.then mixing, cross-origin iframe, failed to start (Docker libs), mochawesome overwrite, video folder empty after v13. This appendix maps message → cause → fix, with Playwright/Selenium cousins where the same product bug would look different.
chapters.why: Reading the error without adding a wait is a senior habit. Many messages name the architecture limit (origin, tab) rather than a bad selector.
chapters.when: Whenever a spec fails, and when onboarding someone who pastes stack traces into Slack.

practical.scenario: A teammate pastes four Cypress errors from CI. You must triage without reproducing yet.
practical.pass: You map each message to timeout vs detached vs origin vs promise vs reporter overwrite vs video default, and you propose the matching fix from this appendix.
practical.fail: You reply 'add cy.wait(10000)' to all four.

chapters.customSummary:
- Timeout: assertion/intercept, not sleep.
- Detached: re-query (retry) or isolation.
- Origin: wrap with cy.origin + args.
- Promise/queue: don't return/await commands wrongly.
- Infra: browsers image, video default, mochawesome two-part.
chapters.contentMarkdown:
## "Timed out retrying after 4000ms: Expected to find element"

Element never appeared, or selector is wrong, or you are on the wrong origin/tab. Fix: time-travel, correct `data-cy`, wait on `@alias`, increase timeout *once* if the API is slow. If the element is in Okta, you forgot `cy.origin` (9.1). If it is in a new tab, it will **never** appear (9.3).

Playwright cousin: `Timeout ... locator`. Selenium: `NoSuchElementException`.

## "cy.origin() must be passed a valid origin" / cross-origin command failure

You interacted with `login.okta.com` without an origin block, or you closed over variables instead of `args`. Fix: 9.1. `chromeWebSecurity: false` is not the first fix.

## "The following error originated from your application code" / uncaught:exception

App threw. Fix the app, or narrowly ignore a known third-party error (11.7). Do not `return false` globally.

## "detached from DOM"

The node was found then React re-rendered. Cypress retries **queries**; if you cached a jQuery object in `.then` and clicked later, you went stale. Fix: `cy.get` again, or chain `.click()` on the query. Selenium: `StaleElementReferenceException`. Playwright: usually re-queries locators for you.

## "Cypress detected that you returned a promise from a command"

You mixed `async/await` or returned a real Promise where the queue expected a chainable. Fix: stay in the queue (`.then`), do not `await cy.get`.

## "cy.wait() could not find a registered alias"

`cy.wait('@leave')` with no `cy.intercept(...).as('leave')`, or intercept registered **after** the request. Fix: intercept first (Part 5). Alias name collision with element aliases — network wait only works on intercept aliases.

## "Cypress could not verify that this server is running"

CI visited before the app bound the port. Fix: `wait-on` in `cypress-io/github-action` (11.1). Wrong `baseUrl` (10.2).

## "Failed to start" / missing dependencies in Docker

You used `node:alpine` without Cypress system libs. Fix: `cypress/browsers` or `cypress/included` (11.2).

## Empty videos / "no videos recorded"

Cypress 13+ `video: false` default (11.8). Set `video: true`.

## Mochawesome report shows one spec

Overwrite from per-spec Mocha (11.6). Two-part merge.

## "You specified a browser named webkit"

Not first-class (9.9). Use Chrome/Firefox/Electron, or Playwright for WebKit.

## Shadow: 0 matches, but DevTools sees the node

Need `.shadow()` / `includeShadowDom: true` (9.4).

## CI green after retries, red locally

Retries hiding flake (10.3, 9.13). Fix the test.

## Versus Playwright and Selenium messages

Playwright: `Error: locator.click: Target closed` (page/tab gone) — in Cypress that often looks like a timeout on the *original* tab. Selenium: `NoSuchWindowException` after a tab closed. Translate the product failure, not the string.

Interview line: "I read Cypress errors as timeout, detached, origin, queue, or infra. I don't sleep them away."
